description: This file defines the main page component for a notes application, managing state, fetching notes and note details from an API, handling user interactions for creating, editing, deleting notes, and routing logic via URL query parameters. It composes several child components like Header, Sidebar, NoteList, NoteView, and NoteEditor.

methods.name: loadNotes
methods.description: Fetches the list of notes from the API and updates state.

methods.name: loadNoteDetail
methods.description: Fetches details of the selected note based on 'selectedId' and updates state.

methods.name: handleNewNote
methods.description: Prepares the UI to create a new note by resetting relevant state and updating URL.

methods.name: handleEditNote
methods.description: Switches the mode to 'edit' for the current note.

methods.name: handleCancelEdit
methods.description: Cancels editing and reverts to view mode or list view.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves a new or updated note via API and updates local state accordingly.

parameters.name: noteData
parameters.description: Data for creating or updating a note.

methods.name: handleDeleteNote
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected note via API and updates UI state.
